title: crataegus tanacetifolia
intro: Crataegus tanacetifolia, commonly known as Midland hawthorn, is a species of hawthorn tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of blood pressure, improvement of lipid profiles, and alleviation of symptoms associated with cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Midland hawthorn are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Midland hawthorn are also believed to have potential anti-arrhythmic and anti-hypertensive effects.
